events.description: Get up-to-date information that affects you as a retired teacher!

Cornwall Curling Club will host the third annual RTA Curling Bonspiel on
Nov. 6, 2026.

We can accommodate 16 teams, and must have at least 12.

Every team must have at least two retired teachers (have taught
anywhere, at any level, and retired).

PEIRTA members enter free. Non-members pay $15.

Six end games, snacks, hot lunch, trivia, prizes, fun fun fun!

Team entries except for Cornwall curlers, who will sign up individually
at our club.

Send entry to Marg Stewart at margstewart@pei.eastlink.ca. Identify
retired teachers and provide a contact phone and email for each person.

Therapeutic Touch ®
events.description:
Therapeutic Touch®️was developed as a complementary modality in 1972 by Prof./Dr. Dolores Krueger of New York University and Dora Kunz and is offered in many countries.  The Atlantic Therapeutic Touch Network formed in 1997 (incorporated) as a not-for-profit and remains active with many volunteers offering sessions to self, family, pets, nursing homes, and even our stand alone Palliative Care Facility.  The modality is a bit mis-named as no touch is required.  Sessions can be as brief as 3-5-10 min. with a deeper sense of relaxation experienced within the first 3 minutes.  A wonderful asset for ones own “tool kit” to assist in self care - in numerous ways from deeper sense of peace/relaxation, deeper sleep level, improvement in focus and attention/mindfulness  

A bonus in learning to use this modality is that one can then use it not only for self care , but offer to those open to receive whether family, friends, or pets.    If at all interested in learning more, please visit our website: 
https://www.atlanticttn.com/contact-attn.html  and/or questions: info@atlanticttn.com
